data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2488 reported an overall prioryear reserve release for 2017. Using the gross claims development table the syndicate shows a net gross release of approximately GBP 31.7m ( -3.3% of opening gross claims reserves), driven by favourable development on older underwriting years (2011-2014) partly offset by adverse development on 2015. The movement note in the accounts reports a net prior year surplus but only provides net (after reinsurance) LOB breakdowns; therefore the gross movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle.

The two most critical assumptions as regards the provision for claims outstanding are that the past is a reasonable predictor of the likely level of claims development and that the rating and other models used for current business are fair reflections of the likely level of ultimate claims to be incurred.

data.data_quality_notes: The 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note in the accounts provides only NET (after reinsurance) class-level figures. A gross prior-year movement was not presented explicitly. Therefore the gross prior-year development (-GBP 31.728m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative ultimates) by comparing each older underwriting year's current estimate to its previous diagonal (excluding 2016 and 2017). LOB-level gross movements are not available in the disclosures, so perLOB amounts are left null and directions inferred from the net movement note where possible. 'Miscellaneous' was mapped to 'Aggregate' for LOB mapping purposes - this is approximate.
